profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Backend & Distributed Systems | Java · Kafka · Kubernetes · AWS
profile.summary:
I build backend systems that don't fall over at scale.
 
Over 10+ years, I've worked across security, healthcare, and e-commerce platforms, taking legacy systems that were breaking under load and rebuilding them into microservices architectures that hold up in production. At SiteLines, it meant building the personalization layer behind B2B product discovery for enterprise catalogs.
 
My toolkit: Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, Kubernetes, AWS, Scala, .NET, SQL, CI/CD.
 
I'm at my best on systems where reliability and scale actually matter - not greenfield toy problems. Open to conversations about senior backend or platform engineering roles.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Extended Sysdig's cloud security platform by building IBM Activity Tracker policy support, enabling automated compliance monitoring across dozens of enterprise customer environments and closing a key coverage gap in the platform's IBM Cloud offering.  
• Engineered backward-compatible validation logic to support rule creation across legacy query structures, preserving compliance functionality for long-term customers without forcing a migration.  
• Refactored complex legacy microservice lists and macros using AI-assisted code analysis (Claude Code), improving code maintainability by ~25% and reducing technical debt across the policy validation system.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Go (Programming Language) · Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
• Led the development of B2B ecommerce microservices and APIs, enhancing customer-specific catalogs and pricing
• Guided technical design and code reviews, ensuring high-quality delivery of scalable ecommerce features
• Collaborated with product, QA, and DevOps teams to improve release quality and production readiness
• Mentored engineers and facilitated architectural discussions on backend services and distributed systems

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed B2B SiteLines features, enhancing business-specific catalogs, pricing, themes, and inventory rules
• Implemented personalized product recommendations to improve product discovery using customer and catalog data
• Built and enhanced backend services utilizing microservices, Kafka, REST APIs, SQL, and cloud-native architecture

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed a hierarchical configuration service for managing YAML-based configurations across multiple environments
• Designed a tree-traversal merge strategy to enhance configuration consistency and performance
• Expanded test coverage with JUnit, significantly improving service reliability
• Collaborated with engineering teams to refine backend workflows and production readiness

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed a secure file-transfer service utilizing PII scan results to ensure compliance and efficient routing.  
• Built a large-file transfer service that streamlined file movement between various locations using JSON configurations.  
• Optimized SQL queries, enhancing system performance by 70%, and implemented a job allocation service for better task distribution.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Microsoft SQL Server · JavaScript Frameworks

positions.title: Student Assistant
positions.description:
- Responsible for digitalizing forms to reduce paper usage using Salesforce, Adobe Sign
- Contributed to Proof of Concept project in BP Logix

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I played a key role in enhancing Cvent’s event management platform through various development and maintenance tasks.  

• Conducted fault analysis and root-cause debugging to resolve production issues and improve application stability.  
• Implemented database changes and interface updates to enhance user experience and application performance.  
• Worked closely with product management to ensure alignment on feature requirements during sprint planning.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
I played a pivotal role in the development and enhancement of ABFAS's certification platform, focusing on delivering high-quality software solutions.  

• Designed and developed application features using ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Core, and SQL Server.  
• Led efforts to implement single sign-on, improving user authentication and platform usability.  
• Focused on code quality and maintainability, ensuring stable production releases and effective collaboration with team members.
